# 🎯 Release: Core Utilities & Configuration Engine (`v0.2.0`)

{{RELEASE_METADATA}}

## 📌 Summary
This release adds a robust configuration manager, Log4j2 logging, screenshot utility, and an enhanced browser factory. The framework can now be configured via `config.properties`, produces structured logs, and captures screenshots on demand.

## 🛠 Key Changes
- [x] Integrated Log4j2 (console + file appenders)
- [x] Added `ConfigReader` – centralised property management
- [x] Added `BrowserFactory` – configurable browser types, headless, slowMo
- [x] Added `ScreenshotUtil` – PNG capture with timestamped filenames
- [x] Refactored all tests to use logging instead of `System.out`
- [x] CI workflows upload `logs/` and `screenshots/` as artifacts

## ✅ Quality Assurance
- Log4j2 configuration validated (no more SLF4J warnings)
- `config.properties` overrides work with environment variables
- Screenshot saved on failure (or manually)
- `pom-validator.sh` passes for v0.2.0 requirements

## 📝 Release Notes
This PR promotes `v0.2.0` from `dev` to `main`. After merging, GitHub Actions will:
1. Create a signed Git tag `v0.2.0`
2. Generate a GitHub Release with auto‑notes
3. Bump `dev` to `v0.3.0-SNAPSHOT` (next minor for Page Object Model)
4. Open a version bump PR (`chore/bump-to-v0.3.0`)

## 🔄 Post-Merge Automation
- Tag `v0.2.0` created on `main`
- GitHub Release published with changelog
- `dev` branch receives the next snapshot version (`0.3.0-SNAPSHOT`)
